kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننهمر (form VII)
# نَنْهَمِرُ (nanhamiru) /nan.ha.mi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
# نَنْهَمِرَ (nanhamira) /nan.ha.mi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
# نَنْهَمِرْ (nanhamir) /nan.ha.mir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
